scope: Conditional source-clause control flow only; dynamic corpus/DOM data are preconditions, not observed accepted outputs. No runtime transport/dependency completeness claim.

semantic_mapping.assessment: A new fragment cancels the earlier frame, resolves a literal owned target, reveals only its ancestors and queues one frame. The frame requires non-aborted connection and connected target; explicit link focus is retained across native hash rescheduling, then scrollIntoView runs. No programmatic history write.

New chapter selection cancels pending animation; click microtask checks abort before resolution. Disconnect aborts the connection controller, removes signal-owned listeners and cancels its frame. Reconnection aborts the previous controller. Stale queued work cannot write history; only native links do.

limits: Only finite conditional source control-flow clauses. No new runtime/browser/build/corpus/installed/whole-machine/task/program acceptance.
Every frozen cited source path is bound, with logic witnesses separate from broader family citation exposure.
Metadata and unrelated staged cancellation changes are outside these inputs. Source epoch is immutable483d; no claim the whole worktree was clean.
